answer: Escrow the payment for graded work. Reduce it by each claim the grader cannot verify. Edge case: a grader who verifies nothing still gets a floor payment, so refusing all work is not free either. Rewards vest against future work, so a farm cannot cash out and vanish. A meadow of clones grading its own answers in an oasis of self-dealing loses the unverified portion every round, while one cedar of honest reviewers keeps the full amount.
